vectors.criterion: A registry constructed with the pinned catalog and five covered packs is graph-enforced and flags exactly the operations without disposition member as inadmissible; under the accepted thermal placement every operation is a member, so none is flagged.
A kernel constructed without the catalog refuses every graph member, so a resource upsert cannot be published unenforced.
Construction with the catalog fails when a registered pack is not covered by the catalog; the synthetic pack has no catalog entry.

An intent for an operation whose catalog disposition is unknown is inadmissible from the registry index alone, even with a qualified capability instance; no expected effect is stated, so no thermal quantity is placed.
A new source epoch after a driver restart never rewrites a resource: the ResourceIDs and revisions stay, while native-basis relation instances die with the retired epoch.
An operator-slot anchor is upgraded to a native identity with the exact previous anchor and binding continuity evidence; the ResourceID stays.
Two units with equal token text under different issuer codes have different anchor keys and stay two resources.
One unit observed through two bindings of its home asset stays one resource; each binding has an identity link naming it.
Two current resources of one kind with one anchor key, here kind inverter with the same operator slot, are never both current.
The kind of a ResourceID never changes; the new kind has the same anchor class, so only the kind differs.
A retired ResourceID is never current again.
An identity link that names a natively anchored resource and carries a key must carry that resource's anchor key; a different token is a false join.
A qualified identity link that names a resource carries a non-empty basis.
An anchor change without supersedes changes the anchor key of a ResourceID and is drift.
A supersession from native_identity to operator_slot is a downgrade and never a supersession.
A native_identity anchor whose scheme is not listed in the registered identification schemes is rejected on the scheme carried in clear; the kernel cannot read the key's digest and does not need to.
An anchor whose basis is not native_identity carries no scheme, even a listed one.

Resources of every anchor class are published: site (function), charging station (equipment), EVSE and connector (component) and a charging session (episode) with its native episode token in its parent.
A fact derived from facts about two resources is published when all inputs are in the one home asset.
A resource whose kind has catalog disposition unknown cannot be instantiated in a graph-enforced kernel.
A resource dimension value resolves to a current resource of the dimension's kind in the same snapshot.
A thermal fact is published only on a resource of its subject kind: a circuit flow temperature whose circuit dimension names a current heat generator is rejected (RES-5).
An in-asset relation instance with an admitted basis class and agreeing origin is accepted.
Two qualified contains instances of different definitions that claim one part violate the forest rule across definitions; the kernel marks both conflict and chooses neither.
Qualified relays instances that form a cycle are accepted and all set to conflict.
An accepted generation fence removes the gate-rule input instances of the fenced generation and keeps the configured system instance; resources stay.
An evidenced absence statement says the inverter has no array relation of this definition; without it the relation would be unknown.

A circuit flow temperature on its thermal circuit is a hydraulic fact instance, and the heat generator's qualified fluid-supply instance to that circuit is a hydraulic relation instance; both definitions are members of the hydraulic and energy planes.
The basis class configuration is admitted by the definition but requires an operator origin; a native-observation origin disagrees.
The basis class agrees with the origin but is not one the definition admits (configuration, gate_rule).
A relation instance whose same-asset to endpoint is withdrawn is rejected, not stored as an edge.
A relation instance that carries a plane-scoped identifier member fails strict decoding of the batch before any rule runs; endpoints are only typed ResourceID values.
The starting end of a relation instance is a current resource homed in the publishing asset.

The configuration provider publishes into the driver's asset as a second source: its configured instance starts at the inverter the driver observes and ends at an array homed in another asset. A fence of the driver's generation removes the driver's gate-rule instance and keeps the contributor's instance; resources stay.

A contributor's configured instance needs an operator origin. The origin here names the contributor's own binding upserted in the same batch, so it resolves and belongs to the batch; only the native-observation origin disagrees with the basis class configuration.

An identity link belongs to the source of the binding it names. The contributor's link for the driver's binding is refused by the kernel's batch ownership rule although its key equals the anchor key, so an operator identity declaration travels in the driver's own batch.
The generated seed catalog, unchanged, registers.
Elements may be members of several planes; no plane is primary and identity is not anchored in a plane.
A catalog that lacks the entry of one accepted pack field is incomplete (CAT-1).
A relation definition in a plane that one endpoint kind does not admit violates closure (PLN-5); energy is allowed for contains, but the string kind is physical only.

An operation is admitted through the target resource's own qualified capability, whose route uses the relaying unit's binding; the relation instance neither adds nor removes a route. The seed catalog holds no member controls definition, so the relation is a member relays instance.

The only path from the capability to the target resource is a relation instance, so zero routes are eligible and the graph is not searched. The seed catalog holds no member controls definition; the path is a member relays instance, and AUT-1 and AUT-3 make the result independent of the core type.
The expected-effect subject must equal the resource of the named capability's service instance; asserting another resource fails the effect derivation.
A capability instance whose definition is in the control plane but whose instance is not qualified grants no control.
One ResourceID current in two members excludes both members; neither is chosen and the cut becomes partial.
A relation whose to endpoint resolves in another member to a kind its definition does not admit is conflict.
A relation whose to endpoint is retired in its home member is stale and in no plane.
Two current resources of one kind with one anchor key in two members are flagged same_unit, for a native key and for one parent and slot; both are kept.
A member that holds a fact of a member definition but no graph record is reported ungraphed.
A relation whose to endpoint is in no member of a complete cut is dangling.
An absence statement in one member that denies a qualified instance held by another makes the instance conflict; the statement is reported, not removed.
One unit seen through two protocols whose native owners map its token to one scheme, issuer and token is flagged same_unit.
A relation whose to endpoint is held by a member this cut excluded is excluded, not outside_cut.
A member that publishes only facts of unknown definitions is not reported ungraphed.
Two resources of one unit whose anchors share no key stay two unflagged resources; the pair is not detectable.
A qualified relation whose to endpoint is current in another member and of an admitted kind is coherent and in the planes of its definition.
A relation whose to endpoint is in no member of a partial cut is outside_cut.
A resource whose anchor parent is not the from of a coherent contains, groups or hosts instance to it keeps its identity and is presented under no parent.
Two snapshots of one asset are invalid cut input and reject the assembly.
More than 256 member snapshots exceed the cut bound and reject the assembly without truncation.
An equipment resource that only relays is in physical and provenance only, although its kind admits energy and another equipment resource beside it is in energy.
A published record never carries a plane member; membership comes only from the catalog.
